name: Tasks.md
tagline: A self-hosted, file based task management board.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  tasks-md:
    container_name: tasks-md
    image: baldissaramatheus/tasks.md:3.3.0
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:8080
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/files:/tasks/
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/config:/config/
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/stylesheets:/usr/share/nginx/html/stylesheets/
    environment:
      - TITLE="${TASKS_MD_TITLE}"
    restart: unless-stopped
